link.note: Named as Jeanne's mother (1696, confirmed); her membership of the Mersereau family of Moëze is 'probable, close to confirmed' (brother Daniel godfather 1689; his wife godmother 1693, 1696; Pierre witness at all three 1693 weddings). No document names her parents outright.

summary: Huguenot wife of Pierre Masse, of the Mersereau family of Moëze in Saintonge, who was in New York by 1689; John's 9th-great-grandmother.
bio: Elizabeth Mersereau, whose name was written Elisabet Mercereau in the French church records, was a Huguenot of the Mersereau family of Moëze in Saintonge, a family that later became well known on Staten Island. She was the wife of Pierre Masse and was living in New York by 1689. Her brother Daniel Mercereau stood as godfather to her son Daniel in 1689, and Daniel's wife, Suzanne Marie Doucinet, was godmother to her son Pierre in 1693 and her daughter Jeanne in 1696. Her siblings Marie, Josué and Daniel, all described as from Moëze in Saintonge, married in New York in July and August 1693. Her parents were presumably Jean Mersereau Sr. and Elisabet Dubois. She is John's 9th-great-grandmother.
sources: Registers of the French Church of New York, Collections of the Huguenot Society of America vol. 1 (1886): https://archive.org/details/collectionsofhug01hugu
Semans & Broome, Broome, Latourette and Mercereau Families
